question: What does the original program do (its core features and screens)? There are no reference pictures and no capture of it running.
probes: Person puts screenshots of the original into reference/
resolution: The person said it controls/programs videos and animations for a 3D hologram fan and stores them on an SD card, and attached two screenshots: a device-type picker with 20 models (10-ND 4.0" … 115-F6 45.3") and a main window with Playing settings (Last one, Single loop, Play/Pause, List loop, Next one), a log list ('Trying to connect to the network of device...'), Device settings (Disconnect, Unconnected, On/Off, Format Disk, Clear Cache, Wi-Fi config), Video settings (Decode video, Upload files, Brightness+/-, CW/CCW adjust), Device status, Clock settings (on/off, needle white/black, dial Digital/Symbol/Zodiac/Constellation, power-on display time H/M/S) and picture play time 5-30 s. Seen in attachments/picture-1.png and picture-2.png.
